name: zanker-production-parity
description: Verify isolated preview matches actual integrated application.

workflow.instruction: List sandbox shims, mocked providers, styles and runtime limitations.
Reproduce in the target framework native server/route when feasible.
Compare shared state, fonts, global CSS, SSR output, hydration and user permissions.
Flag unverified cases and prevent signoff as production-equivalent.

acceptance: No claim of parity without evidence
